headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Iran's IRGC claimed the sinking of a container ship south of Hormuz, and Singapore confirmed its GFS Pride sank after a strike, so the IRGC-claim tripwire fired: escalated war by Nov 3 rises from 7% to 10% and an MOU-style deal falls from 10% to 8%. Year-end odds hold because post-election escalation was already priced in.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
